messages.subject: [Forensim-help] Problems with tabfreq for three populations
messages.subject_clean: [Forensim-help] Problems with tabfreq for three populations
messages.body_plain:
Hello!
?
I've got three populations (dna_eu, dna_or and dna_ne) in data.frames. Now I
want to use tabfreq() to convert these three data.frames into one tabfreq
object. I read, that one has to give a list of data frames in the tab argument.
So I tried:
?
dna_list <- data.list(dna_eu, dna_or, dna_ne)
dna_pop <- tabfreq(tab = dna_list, pop.names = as.factor(c("dna_eu", "dna_or",
"dna_ne")))
?
But now the the error occures, that "all elements of tab must be of types matrix
or data.frame". My question is: What am I doing wrong?
?
I would be very happy and thankful, if you could help me out!
?
Greetings,
Daniela Huber

messages.subject: [Forensim-help] Problems with NGM loci
messages.body_plain:
Hello
I loaded the files containing the genotypes of the victim and the suspect
obtained with NGM kit. All worked well until I clicked "analyse" and than
"OK" in the "analyse the Profile" window. I received an errore message:
  "Error in ProbEvid(stain = (alrep), freq = freq[as.character(alrep)], T =
T,  :
  stain frequencies in  'freq' must be numbers strictly between 0 and 1"
What am I doing wrong? I would be very happy and thankful, if you could
help me!
Thank you
Federica Alessandrini
